selectionRule: No candidate may be selected from catalog data alone. Actual rotating mass, CG, approved bearing loads, drive/brake torque demand, mounting structure, dynamic test evidence and service-clearance evidence must exist first.

publishedManufacturerData: Kaydon publishes slewing-ring families selected using static load parameters and bearing type/gear/envelope inputs.
Kaydon describes RK as a low-velocity/intermittent turntable family and XR cross-roller as high stiffness with low rotational torque within a minimal envelope.
Kaydon publishes KH as a precision-positioning slewing-ring family.
whyRelevant: VX4800 is a low-speed suspended rotating structure requiring combined-load and moment evaluation.
Family breadth allows application review without prematurely selecting a catalog rating.
Low-speed turntable and high-stiffness cross-roller families are credible comparison points for the canopy envelope.
blockers: actual rotating mass and CG unknown
approved axial/radial/moment load envelope absent
mounting ring stiffness/flatness and bolt-load calculation absent
starting/running torque in actual mounted condition unknown
required runout/accuracy from dynamic clearance not established
secondary-retention integration not validated

sources.scope: manufacturer family overview including RK/XR characteristics
manufacturer selector; exact selection requires load and envelope inputs

publishedManufacturerData: Schaeffler states crossed-roller bearings can support axial force in both directions, radial force and tilting moment loads in one bearing position.
Schaeffler describes the family as very rigid with high running accuracy, with clearance/preload options.
whyRelevant: Single-position combined-load support and stiffness are attractive for a shallow canopy.
High running accuracy may benefit carrier runout and sensor air-gap control.
blockers: available diameter/envelope and exact series suitability for VX4800 not established
suspended axial mounting condition and bolt/support design require manufacturer review
starting torque/preload/lubrication tradeoffs not quantified
replaceability and secondary-retention packaging not validated

sources.scope: manufacturer technical pocket guide; crossed-roller combined-load, rigidity and running-accuracy reference

familiesOfInterest: multiple support rollers on circular rail with dedicated axial capture
whyRelevant: Can distribute support around a large diameter and make individual rollers serviceable.
blockers: load sharing and rail flatness become system-level engineering problems
more rolling interfaces increase alignment, noise, wear and inspection burden
separate axial/overturning retention is required
no single supplier calculation closes the complete support architecture

whyRelevant: Low axial height may be attractive inside the 150 mm canopy.
blockers: low section height alone does not prove sufficient moment stiffness or suspended-load bolt behavior
may require paired/support architecture that removes the apparent packaging benefit
secondary retention and runout requirements remain unresolved

driveCandidates.architecture: fixed gearmotor/reducer drives a positive synchronous belt engaging a dedicated concentric toothed ring/pulley on the rotating hub/carrier
referenceManufacturers: SEW-EURODRIVE or equivalent industrial gearmotor supplier
publishedManufacturerData: Gates Poly Chain GT Carbon is a synchronous positive-drive belt system and is published as a clean drive requiring no lubrication; exact belt/pulley sizing remains application-specific.
SEW-EURODRIVE publishes spring-loaded brake families that are electrically released and apply when power is interrupted.
strengths: positive engagement supports deterministic motion without friction-wheel slip
belt can mechanically isolate some gearmesh noise and avoids lubricated open ring teeth
drive ring can remain structurally separate from primary bearing load path
blockers: required torque and reduction ratio cannot be selected before inertia/friction/drag load cases exist
custom ring/pulley diameter, belt length, tooth engagement, pretension and guard layout unresolved
belt resonance/tooth excitation at ultra-low carrier speed and reducer input speed must be tested
brake torque and stopping profile unselected

sources.scope: manufacturer synchronous-belt family reference; exact size and rating not selected
manufacturer 2026 spring-loaded brake operating-principle reference; exact brake/gearmotor not selected

driveCandidates.architecture: fixed gearmotor/reducer and pinion drive a dedicated internal or external gear ring on the rotating assembly
blockers: gear mesh noise/backlash/lubrication
alignment depends on carrier/bearing runout
guarding and service access
bearing-integral gear requires exact bearing and gear review

driveCandidates.architecture: fixed friction wheel drives a rotating track
blockers: slip undermines deterministic feedback
normal force adds radial reaction
wear/contamination affect torque
holding cannot rely on friction alone

driveCandidates.architecture: coaxial or central reducer couples directly to rotating hub
strengths: compact torque path if a suitable reducer fits the structural hub
blockers: crowds bearing/service zone
backlash/stiction at extreme reduction
manual release and retention packaging harder

publishedManufacturerData: SEW-EURODRIVE describes BR/BY/BZ brakes as spring-loaded, electrically opened brakes.
The manufacturer states the brake applies when power is interrupted.
brakeReferenceCandidates.useBoundary: Useful reference for parking/power-loss architecture only. Exact stopping/holding torque, thermal duty and any functional-safety option require exact selected variant and system risk assessment.

feedbackCandidates.architecture: powered readhead fixed to canopy/hub support reads passive rotary scale ring on rotating hub
publishedManufacturerData: Renishaw publishes rotary optical encoder systems using steel ring scales with readheads.
Published family combinations include rotary scale diameters from 52 mm to 550 mm depending on readhead/scale family.
strengths: high resolution supports slow-speed verification and controlled stop positioning
blockers: air-gap/runout/contamination tolerance not derived
may be over-specified versus simpler proximity targets

feedbackCandidates.architecture: fixed readhead reads axially magnetised passive ring on rotating hub
publishedManufacturerData: RLS AksIM-4 is a non-contact off-axis absolute magnetic encoder for larger-diameter systems and consists of an axially magnetised ring plus readhead.
blockers: exact ring size, mounting tolerances, interface and environmental suitability for VX4800 not selected

feedbackCandidates.architecture: two fixed non-contact sensors read passive ferrous/magnetic multi-target ring; separate passive index target provides reference
strengths: supports independent index and motion plausibility
blockers: target count/response must derive from 0.08 rpm fault-detection latency
not continuous absolute angle unless target coding added
